article.hook: You spot the person who won’t stop asking why, even when the answer’s right there. The Sun moves through Sagittarius and suddenly honesty isn’t just polite - it’s urgent and loud.
article.lived: For about four weeks, we stretch conversations into questions that dig past small talk and social ease. You notice yourself pulling books off shelves, scrolling through unfamiliar ideas, or pressing people for their real views, not just the rehearsed ones. The day feels too short to stick to what you already know. We live in a pulse of widening the frame and testing what we claim to believe.
article.turn: The problem rides in when curiosity becomes a weapon of insistence, pushing people to prove their truth on your terms. What started as open exploration can tighten into arguing for the sake of winning or dodging responsibility behind lofty words. Stop proving and start living what you say - or you’ll only build a tower of sound with no ground beneath it.
moves: Ask one person a question you don’t already know the answer to and listen without interrupting.
Read a viewpoint you expect to reject, and write one line about what it teaches you.
Say aloud one belief you hold, then describe how you live it this week.
